name: John Murphy, Harriet Murphy, tavern keeper

proprietors.name: John Murphy
proprietors.basis: THE TRADE IS THE SOURCE'S; THE HOUSE IS THE INFERENCE. John Murphy carries dated role(s) of `tavern_keeper` that cover 1835-07-01, graded attested on andreas_1884_v1, drloih_hotels. That the trade was followed at Chicago in window is what the source says; that it was followed in a house of this keeper's own is this record's inference, and it is graded `inferred` for that reason and never promoted. The keeper held no workplace in the business layer before T-1404.

locations.basis: THE KEEPER'S CARD ALREADY PUTS THIS TRADE IN THIS ROOF. hh_murphy_john carries `works_at: exchange_coffee_house` at attested on andreas_1884_v1, and that structure's own committed `function` reads `tavern_inn` — the term this trade's premises ruling names. A `works_at` that named a roof of another function would be a BUILT-BY link rather than a workplace and is refused here. The tier is capped at `inferred` because the house itself is an inference: it is the firm, not the roof, that no source prints.

dates.basis: The role's bound is the SOURCE's span and not the house's: nothing says when this shop opened or closed. The record stands on the scene date because the role covers it, and bounds neither end.

proprietor_community.basis: The 2 keeper(s) this record names and the resident layer holds a card for all read irish: Harriet Murphy (irish), John Murphy (irish). A house is not its keeper, so the reading is an inference about the house and is capped there.

replaceable_by: raised_for_an_in_window_trade: raised by tools/complete_inwindow_trades.py because the keeper's dated role covers 1835-07-01 and the layer held no workplace for them. Retired or rewritten by any printing that names this house — a notice, a directory line or a biography giving its style, its street or its partners — and by an identity ruling that makes this keeper one of the 52 printed keepers the register could not match to a card.
